title: Dacy's Trident Crafting Recipe
description: This data-pack adds a crafting recipe for the Trident
body:
This data-pack adds a trident crafting recipe, The trident is a weapon that can be thrown and is usually very rare, I'd recommend using this data-pack anywhere as getting a trident in the base game is extremely difficult and tedious.
